vb_textbox.text: Try to make selections fast, which side you pick doesn't seem to matter but green and brown seemed to give more success than red and purple though I cannot guarantee it. The game has no mechanic for pausing and no built-in break so if you need to eat/drink/etc you'll want to do it before your twenty minutes in Gnome Hell. I have been changed forever on a psychological level. My hopes that you do not succumb to The Horrors
